# infisical_instance_details (Data Source)

Read details about the Infisical instance the provider is connected to, such as the AWS account ID to trust in an IAM role's trust policy. Works with any authentication method.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
    aws = {
      source = "hashicorp/aws"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

data "infisical_instance_details" "this" {}

# Trust policy for an IAM role that an Infisical AWS App Connection assumes.
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "infisical_trust" {
  statement {
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${data.infisical_instance_details.this.aws_account_id}:root"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = ["<your-infisical-project-id>"]
    }
  }
}

output "infisical_aws_account_id" {
  value = data.infisical_instance_details.this.aws_account_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `aws_account_id` (String) The AWS account ID Infisical acts as when it assumes an IAM role in your AWS account, for example for an AWS App Connection. Name this account as the trusted principal in the role's trust policy. Null when the instance has no AWS identity, or when the Infisical server is too old to report it.
